configurePresets.name: StandaloneRelease
configurePresets.description: Optimised standalone exe that must stay bit-exact with the Debug one. Needs `conan install . -s build_type=Release` (deps in build/Release/generators) first, and -DGTASA_PYTHON=<python>. See .notes/PHASE2_STATUS.md (StandaloneRelease).

configurePresets.name: StandaloneDetached
configurePresets.displayName: StandaloneRelease + detached globals (NOTSA_GLOBAL are real C++ variables) + boot dump for tools/standalone/verify_globals.py
configurePresets.description: Slice A2 of .notes/DETACH_DATA_PLAN.md. Same flags as StandaloneRelease, separate build dir, GTASA_DETACHED_GLOBALS=ON and GTASA_VERIFY_GLOBALS=ON (run with NOTSA_VERIFY_GLOBALS=<file>).
